source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    blocks = [(r, c) for r in range(h - 1) for c in range(w - 1)
              if grid[r][c] == grid[r][c + 1] == grid[r + 1][c] == grid[r + 1][c + 1] == 2]
    blocks.sort(key=lambda p: (p[1], p[0]))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    last = len(blocks) - 1
    for i, (r, c) in enumerate(blocks):
        if (last - i) % 2 == 0:
            for y in (r, r + 1):
                for x in (c, c + 1):
                    out[y][x] = 8
    return out
'''
